name: wds_mscoco_captions
description: A WebDataset-format collection of MS COCO image-caption pairs intended for training and evaluating image captioning and vision-language retrieval models. It reproduces the standard COCO captions data in a streaming-friendly format so models can be trained at scale or evaluated on caption quality and retrieval performance. Typical uses include supervised captioning, contrastive pretraining, and image-text retrieval experiments.
reputation: Widely used as a standard captioning/retrieval resource (COCO captions are a common benchmark and pretraining source).
